messages.author: 1456b138e55fdbe1
messages.subject: Incorrect mouse-over behavior in 'non-NULL' state
parts:
Hello,

I'm developing a(n) (IMO) large App in which one ggvisOutput() is a so-called volcano plot. ggvisOutput()'s 'plot_id' for this div is "volcano_plot" in the gist for which the command to launch it should read:
--
> shiny::runGist("176934a2c0e3f4c5e19521ad953ebdca")
--

In the tabPanel("Differential Expression Plots") that hosts this volcano plot, the user can select a different value for "Contrast" using a selectInput(), after which the data to be displayed in the plot should be updated. However, after selecting a different value (that is, when, 'in shiny::observeEvent() terms', the input is not NULL anymore), which data point (i.e., dot) in the plot gets 'highlighted' by an increased marker size upon 'hovering' over a particular data point as well as the information displayed in the associated tooltip are wrong. This is easily seen by comparing the result of hovering over the same data point before and after changing the "Contrast" from the default "C118_HFD" to (for example) "CORT_C118" and then back to "C118_HFD".

I have isolated the volcano plot visualization including the selectInput() to a separate App for debugging, and found that enclosing the ggvis() call in "server.R" in an observeEvent() 'handlerExpr' apparently resolved the problem (in that separate App). However, after having plugged the isolated solution into the full-fledged App I don't get it working there, i.e. the problem as described above is still present.

I tried several alternatives (in the full-fledged App): observeEvent() (which didn't work due to an obvious cause), reactive(), and eventReactive(), all to no avail.

I ran the App with "Client/Server Tracing" as described on "https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/debugging.html", and thereby found some (IMO) remarkable things that might help in resolving the issue, but I'm afraid that I'm unable to interpret the JSON code sufficiently myself. I'll be happy to post snippets (e.g. of Linux's 'diff' output) if desired, and *can* (FWIW) mention at least that the problematic 'mouse-over' and tooltip behavior appeared to be associated with a relatively large proportion of "SEND {"busy":"idle"}" and "SEND {"busy":"busy"}" echoes to the console.

I suspect (without having further knowledge) that the described issues might have to do with 'observers floating around' (with reference to "https://github.com/rstudio/ggvis/issues/254" - aka, a "lapsed listener problem"?) and that this problem gets worse when Shiny Apps grow, but please correct me if I'm wrong.

Thank you in advance for your help.
